gloss: to fight, to battle, to struggle

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}と{戦|たたか}う。
{勇敢|ゆうかん}に{戦|たたか}った。

notes:
{戦|たたか}う is a godan verb meaning to fight, battle, or struggle.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)

PARTICLE PATTERN:
- Xと{戦|たたか}う: to fight against X
- Xに{戦|たたか}う: to fight for X (cause)

USAGE CONTEXTS:
- {戦争|せんそう}: war, combat
- スポーツ: sports competitions
- {病気|びょうき}と{戦|たたか}う: to fight illness
- {困難|こんなん}と{戦|たたか}う: to struggle against hardship

KANJI VARIANTS:
- {戦|たたか}う: general fighting, war ({戦争|せんそう})
- {闘|たたか}う: struggle, battle ({闘争|とうそう})
Both are read たたかう; {闘|たたか}う emphasizes intense struggle.

RELATED:
- {戦|たたか}い: fight, battle (noun)
- {戦士|せんし}: warrior
- {戦闘|せんとう}: combat
